description: Call this right after a fetch, scrape or API call fails and stops your task: HTTP 403, HTTP 429, CAPTCHA, Cloudflare challenge, login wall, an empty page that needs JavaScript, PDF-only content, or a page that has gone. Returns an official API or open dataset for the same data where one is known, plus a log id. Does not bypass CAPTCHAs or bot protection. Free, takes seconds.
